_note: 英文词典源文件：key 为中文原文（gettext 风格 msgid），value 为英文。改完后运行 node tools/sync-i18n.js 注入 task-timer-app.html。
修改后保存，倒计时进度会按新设置重新计算。: Saving recalculates the countdown using the new settings.
为任务设置一个倒计时，或指定截止时间。: Give the task a countdown, or set a deadline.
保存后立即开始计时: Start counting down right after saving
关闭则先保存为「未开始」，稍后手动启动: Off: saved as "Not started", start it later
关闭后仍会弹出页面内提醒: In-page alerts still appear when this is off
点主题按钮切换深浅色，手机端在顶栏右上角、电脑端在侧栏右下角；两套主题共用同一布: Tap the theme button to switch light/dark — top-right on phones, bottom-right of the sidebar on desktop. Both themes share the same layout and motion.
选一个强调色，按钮、进度条、选中与焦点状态都会跟随；「恢复默认」还原初始配色。: Pick an accent colour; buttons, progress bars, selection and focus states follow it. “Restore default” brings back the original palette.
跟随壁纸生成强调色，背景保持中性: Accent colour derived from the wallpaper; backgrounds stay neutral
全部数据保存在本机，不上传服务器。: All data is stored on this device and never uploaded.
切换界面语言，立即生效。: Switch the interface language. Applies immediately.
倒计时：设定时长（如 25 分钟），开始后倒数。截止时间：指定日期时刻，剩余时间: Countdown: set a duration (25 minutes, say) and it counts down once started. Deadline: pick a date and time; the remaining time ticks down in real time.
倒计时可暂停，暂停期间剩余时间冻结，恢复后接着走，刷新页面不丢进度。截止时间模式: A countdown can be paused: the remainder freezes, resumes where it stopped, and survives a reload. Deadline mode cannot be paused.
倒计时归零或截止时间到达时，页面内始终弹出提醒；开启「提示音 + 系统通知」还会: When a countdown hits zero or a deadline arrives, an in-page alert always appears. With "Sound + system notification" on, it also chimes and posts a system notification once permitted.
任务页右上「排序」菜单可切换排序方式、分组方式与状态筛选。: The "Sort" menu in the top-right of the task page switches sorting, grouping and status filtering.
请设置大于 0 的时长: Duration must be greater than zero
读取本地数据失败，已从空列表开始: Could not read local data; starting from an empty list
文件内容不是对象: File content is not an object
覆盖会清空当前全部数据，确定继续吗？: Replacing erases all current data. Continue?
再次确认：真的要清空全部数据吗？: Confirm once more: erase all data?
有任务在离线期间到期: Tasks came due while you were away
当前标签与状态筛选下没有任务，可清除筛选或切换标签。: No tasks under this tab and filter. Clear the filter or switch tabs.
点击右下角「新建」，为它设置倒计时或截止时间。: Tap "New" at the bottom right to give it a countdown or a deadline.
按 N 新建任务: Press N for a new task
系统通知：未授权 · 点击此处授权: System notifications: not allowed · tap to allow
系统通知：未授权 · 可在系统设置中开启: System notifications: not allowed · enable in system settings
系统通知：已被拒绝（可在浏览器地址栏站点设置中恢复）: System notifications: blocked (re-enable in the browser's site settings)
系统通知：未授权 · 点击页面任意处时会询问: System notifications: not allowed · you will be asked on the next tap
当前环境不支持系统通知，将仅使用页面内提醒: System notifications are unavailable here; in-page alerts only
系统通知已被浏览器拒绝，将在页面内提醒: System notifications are blocked; using in-page alerts
未授予通知权限，将仅使用页面内提醒: Notification permission not granted; in-page alerts only
倒计时结束或截止时间到达时提醒你: Remind me when the countdown ends or the deadline arrives
将删除全部 {n} 个任务，且无法恢复。确定继续吗？: This deletes all {n} tasks and cannot be undone. Continue?
将导入 {n} 个任务。\\n\\n确定 = 合并（按 id 去重，保留较新的）:
Import {n} tasks.

OK = merge (dedupe by id, keep the newer)
Cancel = replace all
备份版本过新（v{v}）: Backup is from a newer version (v{v})
到期时提示音和系统通知: Sound and system notification when due
截止时间任务无需开始: Deadline tasks start on their own
